name: accounts-refused
description: The commands of the accounts refuse a plugin without accounts, an invalid or used name, an undeclared kind, an undefined account, stored records of another form and a cancel of a login that does not run before any host call.
reason: The account programs belong to a plugin that the Go producer does not install; the host tests of the account runs hold the replies (packages/host/go/src/account_run_test.go).
